the heterojunction of ZnS/g C₃N₄ with high catalytic efficiency was successfully prepared by the in situ hydrothermal synthesis method, which was attributed to the synergism between the high defect content of ZnS and the wide absorption band of g C₃N₴.

a new ZnS/g C 3N 4 heterojunction is successfully prepared through in situ hydrothermal reaction, and the defect rich ZnS and bulk g C3N 4 synergistically enhanced the photocatalytic activity, and the ZSCN heterostructure with 0.05 mass fraction exhibited the best photocatalytic performance.

the defect rich ZnS was successfully synthesized through the coordination of Zn2+ with S2- released from glutathione, and then combined with bulk g C3N 4 to form a heterojunction with excellent photocatalytic performance.
